{
  "reasoning": "The model was asked to perform two parallel confidence interval calculations (one with sample size 50, one with 150), but only executed one function call with an incorrect function name. The evaluation expected two `confidence_interval.calculate` calls in parallel.",
  "error_identification": "Two distinct issues: (1) Function name mismatch—model used `confidence_interval_calculate` instead of the correct `confidence_interval.calculate`; (2) Missing second parallel call—only one calculation was made when two were requested.",
  "root_cause_analysis": "The model appears to have misidentified the function namespace/naming convention (using underscore instead of dot notation) and failed to recognize that the user's request for two scenarios with different sample sizes required two separate parallel function invocations.",
  "correct_approach": "Execute two parallel calls to `confidence_interval.calculate` with identical parameters except for `sample_size` (50 and 150 respectively). Ensure the function name matches the exact tool specification provided in the BFCL benchmark.",
  "key_insight": "Parallel test scenarios require the model to identify multiple independent requests and invoke the correct function multiple times. Verify function naming conventions (dot notation vs. underscore) match the tool group specification exactly."
}

Guidance:
- If the evaluation PASSED, many cases you would return an empty operation list. Propose removals or updates when the current playbook conflicts with the verified behaviour as to need to be updated.
- If the evaluation FAILED, add, modify, or remove bullets narrowly targeted to the failure described in the summary/details.
- Keep updates scoped to the triggering context unless the pattern is clearly systemic.
- Keep content under 160 characters. Return an empty list when no update is needed.

Return JSON with keys "reasoning" (<=2 sentences) and "operations".

  {"type": "MODIFY", "section": "<tool_group>", "ID": "<existing id>", "content": "<short bullet>"}
  {"type": "REMOVE", "section": "<tool_group>", "ID": "<existing id>"}
